title: Scalar normalization of the chart left comparison
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes are separated of finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On either the ordinary etale or pro-etale site let $\mathcal C_{T,R}=D^b_{ctf}(T,R)$ mean the full category of constant-$R$ module complexes with bounded constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude: tensor with any degree-zero module sheaf has cohomology in one fixed finite interval [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude, det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer]. Write $T_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The finite Tate line is $R_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}R_T$ on the etale site and its comparison inverse image on the pro-etale site; $(d)$ denotes tensor with its $d$th tensor power [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist].
Let $e:U\to V=\mathbf A^d_Y$ be separated etale of finite type, put $g=p_de$, and choose compactifications of $e,p_d,g$ with middle schemes in the standing setting [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. On the ordinary etale site write $E_R=De_{\Sigma!,R}$ for exact sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension], $F_{d,R}=Rp_{d!,R}$ and $F_{g,R}=Rg_{!,R}$ for the chosen compact-support candidates [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Let $c_{e,R}:F_{e,R}\xrightarrow{\sim}E_R$ be the graph-normalized comparison, let $\alpha_R:F_{d,R}F_{e,R}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{g,R}$ be canonical composition with the chosen common-refinement identifications, and put $\lambda_R=\alpha_R\circ F_{d,R}(c_{e,R}^{-1}):F_{d,R}E_R\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{g,R}$ [def-sp-etale-adjoint-chart-comparison, def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization]. Let $\sigma_e:T_VE_A\xrightarrow{\sim}E_BT_U$ be summandwise tensor and let $\beta_d,\beta_g$ be the proper-counit/open-tensor coefficient maps [lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility]. On $\mathcal C_{U,A}$, $\lambda_R$ is an isomorphism and
$$\beta_g\circ T_Y(\lambda_A)=\lambda_BT_U\circ F_{d,B}(\sigma_e)\circ\beta_d E_A.$$
The comparison $\lambda_R$ carries the composite of the affine-space adjunction and $E_R\dashv e_R^*$ to the adjunction for $F_{g,R}$, retaining its sum-then-affine counit. The equation holds for every specified compactification via its canonical common-refinement comparison. No flatness of $B$ over $A$ is assumed.
